sources.title: Dark Matter Candidates from Particle Physics and Methods of Detection

evidence.text: Which dark matter candidates motivated by particle physics problems have viable production mechanisms, and how could laboratory, collider and astrophysical observations identify them?

sources.title: Dynamical Dark Matter: I. Theoretical Overview

evidence.text: Can a large ensemble of unstable dark-matter components remain cosmologically viable by balancing shorter lifetimes against smaller abundances, and can a Kaluza–Klein tower naturally realize this balance?

sources.title: Millicharge or Decay: A Critical Take on Minimal Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can Minimal Dark Matter remain viable when electric neutrality or a Planck-scale cutoff is relaxed, and what relic-abundance and gamma-ray signatures follow?

sources.title: Rescuing Massive Photons from the Swampland

evidence.text: Can inflationary fluctuations produce all dark matter as a light vector while its scalar partners and ultraviolet cutoff remain above the inflationary Hubble scale?

sources.title: Dark Photon Dark Matter from a Network of Cosmic Strings

evidence.text: Can a cosmic string network formed by the same symmetry breaking that generates a dark photon mass produce the observed abundance of ultralight, nonrelativistic vector dark matter?

sources.title: Ultralight fermionic dark matter

evidence.text: Can many distinct, nearly degenerate fermionic species constitute ultralight dark matter while evading the single-species Tremaine-Gunn bound, and what gravitational production, cosmological, and black-hole constraints limit their number?

sources.title: Higher spin dark matter

evidence.text: Can gravitational production during inflation supply all dark matter as massive bosonic particles with spin greater than two, and can directional nuclear recoils reveal their spin?

sources.title: Dark Matter

evidence.text: What observations support dark matter, what can constitute it, how might it be produced, and how can astrophysical, laboratory and collider searches constrain its properties?

sources.title: Dark sector tunneling field potentials for a dark big bang

evidence.text: Which parameters of a quartic dark-sector tunnelling potential permit a Dark Big Bang under the cosmological bounds adopted in the paper, and can the newly identified parameter region produce all dark matter with observable gravitational-wave signatures?

sources.title: Dark matter candidates and searches

evidence.text: What could dark matter be, how could its abundance have arisen, and how do laboratory, astrophysical, and collider searches constrain the leading proposals?

sources.title: New cosmological constraints on primordial black holes

evidence.text: How do quark/gluon emission and updated light-element and photon-background observations constrain the initial PBH abundance over 10^9–10^17 g? The paper also reviews constraints extending to much larger, nonevaporating PBHs.

sources.title: Primordial Black Hole production in Critical Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: Can critical Higgs inflation, including running of both the Higgs self-coupling and its non-minimal gravitational coupling, produce enough primordial black holes to explain dark matter while satisfying CMB and particle-physics constraints?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Can a hidden confining sector motivated by string constructions supply dark matter through glueballs?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Can an ultralight scalar preserve successful large-scale dark-matter behavior while altering small-scale structure? The supplied text identifies a 10⁻²²–10⁻²¹ eV mass range but ends before explaining the mechanism or connecting it quantitatively to wormholes.

sources.title: Dark Horse, Dark Matter: Revisiting the $SO$(16)x $SO$(16)' Nonsupersymmetric Model in the LHC and Dark Energy Era

evidence.text: Could hidden bound states in the compactified orthogonal gauge theory provide dark matter, and could the bifundamental connector make them observable? The relevant unknowns include confinement scales, stability, production, decay and reheating history.

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Can the primordial HST black-hole gas evolve into a surviving mass distribution consistent with observations and potentially supply dark matter?

sources.title: Black hole mergers in holographic space time models of cosmology

evidence.text: Do black holes in the early matter-dominated era of HST inflation models merge into sufficiently long-lived objects to violate observational constraints, and can their groups instead form bound structures before evaporation?

sources.title: Through the looking glass into the dark dimension: Searching for bulk black hole dark matter with microlensing of <math altimg="si6.svg" display="inline" id="d1e142"><mi mathvariant="bold-italic">X</mi></math>-ray pulsars

evidence.text: Can X-ray pulsar microlensing probe primordial black holes propagating in the dark-dimension bulk, including masses whose all-dark-matter interpretation is excluded for ordinary evaporating four-dimensional Schwarzschild black holes?

sources.title: New cosmological constraints on primordial black holes

evidence.text: The extragalactic photon calculation integrates evolving PBH emission over cosmic time with redshift and propagation limits. Abundance caps touch upper 1σ observational error tips; known astrophysical contributions are not subtracted.

sources.title: Dark Matter Candidates from Particle Physics and Methods of Detection

evidence.text: Thermal relic abundances are obtained numerically from dn/dt = −3Hn − ⟨σAv⟩(n²−neq²), with an approximate freeze-out criterion n⟨σAv⟩ = H. Chemical freeze-out is distinguished from kinetic decoupling.

sources.title: Dynamical Dark Matter: I. Theoretical Overview

evidence.text: Prompt decays and a continuum density of lifetimes permit analytic abundance evolution. Numerical calculations use tower eigenvalues without the asymptotic overlap approximations; effective equations of state are extracted from numerical logarithmic slopes.

sources.title: Millicharge or Decay: A Critical Take on Minimal Dark Matter

evidence.text: SU(2) characters, a plethystic exponential and residue evaluation count singlets and triplets in symmetric cubic products, identifying potentially destabilizing scalar operators.

sources.title: Primordial Black Hole production in Critical Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: The authors compute exact inflationary background evolution and scan (β,ξ₀,x_c,c), choosing λ₀ to match the observed CMB scalar amplitude. They examine n_s, its running and r together with the height and width of the small-scale peak.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Solve section-degree constraints without denominator coordinates, extract minimal divisor factors, and identify the candidate fiber. Check monodromy and matter separately before concluding non-Higgsability.

sources.title: Fuzzy dark matter and the dark dimension

evidence.text: Can the radion of a micron-sized dark dimension be ultralight fuzzy dark matter, and can inflaton-fed KK graviton cascades supply its cosmological abundance?

sources.title: The COSMIC WISPers White Paper: The physics case for Weakly Interacting Slim Particles

evidence.text: What motivates very weakly interacting sub-GeV particles, and how can cosmology, astrophysics and laboratory searches test their roles in dark matter and other unresolved phenomena?

sources.title: A Mini Review of some Dark Matter/BSM Physics and a Bit More

evidence.text: Which connections between dark matter candidates, underlying BSM physics, cosmological consistency and detection strategies provide useful physical insights? This is a subjective review, including excluded or potentially excludable ideas, rather than a systematic assessment of surviving models.

sources.title: Snowmass Theory Frontier: Astrophysics and Cosmology

evidence.text: Which theoretical advances enable searches for dark matter and early-universe physics, improve cosmological inference, and connect observations to fundamental theory? What work should receive priority over the following decade?

sources.title: Hidden Charged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exact hidden charge conservation stabilize thermal dark matter while satisfying relic-abundance, small-scale structure, enhanced-annihilation and halo self-interaction constraints?

sources.title: Report of the Topical Group on Cosmic Probes of Fundamental Physics for for Snowmass 2021

evidence.text: How can cosmic particles and gravitational waves probe cosmological tensions, neutrino properties, early-Universe physics and dark matter beyond laboratory reach?

sources.title: Landscape, Swampland, and Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: Can the small dark-energy density be understood through an infinite-distance decompactification limit with one micron-scale dark dimension, while accommodating dark matter, neutrino masses and cosmology?

sources.title: Snowmass Cosmic Frontier Report

evidence.text: Which cosmic observations and complementary searches can identify dark matter and its origin, distinguish dark energy from modified gravity, determine inflationary dynamics and energy scale, constrain neutrino masses, and discover new particles or interactions?

sources.title: Two Micron‐Size Dark Dimensions

evidence.text: Under what conditions can two compact dimensions of micron size, with species scale near 10 TeV, satisfy collider, astrophysical and cosmological constraints and support dark-matter candidates?

sources.title: Probing Dynamics of Boson Stars by Fast Radio Bursts and Gravitational Wave Detection

evidence.text: Can a very light scalar have a sufficiently small primordial displacement and later constitute a fraction of dark matter in boson stars?

sources.title: Super-resonant dark matter

evidence.text: Can approximately supersymmetric dark QCD naturally generate the exceptionally small resonance splitting needed for velocity-dependent dark-matter self-interactions, fit the adopted dwarf-to-cluster halo constraints, and produce the relic abundance?

sources.title: Gravitino Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can noncatastrophic gravitino production explain dark matter, and can the GSC be related to other proposed quantum-gravity constraints? The paper develops neither an abundance calculation nor an implication involving the GSC.

sources.title: Dark Matter and Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Can dark matter carry an unbroken long-range U(1)D interaction while satisfying thermal-relic, radiation-density and galactic-dynamics constraints, and could the resulting neutral dark plasma have observable collective effects?

sources.title: Double-Disk Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can a subdominant interacting dark-matter component satisfy the paper's observational bounds, dissipate energy into a galactic disk and produce distinguishable gravitational or particle-detection signatures?

sources.title: Cold dark matter: controversies on small scales

evidence.text: Can baryonic galaxy-formation physics resolve the central-density and satellite discrepancies of collisionless CDM simulations, or do these discrepancies require different dark-matter properties?

sources.title: Dark matter self-interactions via collisionless shocks in cluster mergers

evidence.text: Can collective plasma effects make a subdominant charged dark-matter component effectively collisional in cluster mergers, despite negligible binary scattering, while allowing thermal production and compatibility with the cosmological constraints considered?

sources.title: Non-Abelian dark matter and dark radiation

evidence.text: Can WIMP dark matter charged under a very weak non-Abelian gauge group produce distinctive particle-search signals, interacting dark radiation and smooth suppression of structure?

sources.title: A new constraint on millicharged dark matter from galaxy clusters

evidence.text: Can preservation of observed, gravity-dominated galaxy-cluster dark-matter profiles constrain a small dark-matter electric charge through the effects of cluster magnetic fields?

sources.title: Forays into the dark side of the swamp

evidence.text: Can a decreasing exchanged-scalar mass increase dark-matter scattering without appreciably varying the dark-matter mass?

sources.title: New Limits on Charged Dark Matter from Large-Scale Coherent Magnetic Fields

evidence.text: Can cumulative angular-momentum transfer from a rotating, magnetized galactic ISM to a more slowly rotating charged dark-matter halo constrain the dark-matter charge-to-mass ratio through the absence of severe gas-disk contraction?

sources.title: Continuum-Mediated Self-Interacting Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exchange through a gapped, nearly conformal mediator sector generate dark matter self-interactions with non-integer velocity scaling that accommodate small-scale halo observations while satisfying cluster constraints? What Sommerfeld enhancement accompanies these interactions?

sources.title: Astrophysical plasma instabilities induced by long-range interacting dark matter

evidence.text: Can collective plasma streaming instabilities constrain millicharged or dark-U(1)-charged dark matter more strongly than particle collisions in cosmological systems, and change existing galactic disk spin-down constraints?

sources.title: Super-resonant dark matter

evidence.text: Can approximately supersymmetric dark QCD naturally generate the exceptionally small resonance splitting needed for velocity-dependent dark-matter self-interactions, fit the adopted dwarf-to-cluster halo constraints, and produce the relic abundance?

sources.title: On the cosmological abundance of magnetic monopoles

evidence.text: Can astrophysical magnetic fields constrain cosmological monopole abundance through Debye shielding, and what electromagnetic and gravitational bounds remain on nonrelativistic monopoles, including monopole dark matter?

sources.title: Structure formation with dark magnetohydrodynamics

evidence.text: How do collective dark-plasma effects and background dark magnetic fields modify gravitational collapse, directional Jeans scales, and the linear matter power spectrum in a secluded dark sector?

sources.title: Dark Matter and Dark Radiation

evidence.text: Estimate additional effects using dipole bremsstrahlung, Thomson drag from dark radiation, and the linear Weibel growth rate associated with anisotropic plasma velocities. Nonlinear plasma evolution is not calculated.

sources.title: Double-Disk Dark Matter

evidence.text: Tracks separately conserved visible/dark entropy after thermal decoupling, estimates additional effective neutrino species and applies standard analytic thermal-freezeout calculations to the heavy symmetric relic.

sources.title: Cold dark matter: controversies on small scales

evidence.text: Galaxy mass modeling compares cored and NFW-like halo rotation curves while including stellar and gas contributions and uncertainties. Dwarf stellar dynamics provides central-mass estimates, whose correspondence to simulated subhalo properties requires care.

sources.title: Dark matter self-interactions via collisionless shocks in cluster mergers

evidence.text: Assesses BBN through extra radiation, estimates kinetic decoupling by equating dark Compton scattering and Hubble rates, and compares radiative cooling times with astrophysical times. A Landau-pole condition supplies an additional ultraviolet-dependent bound.

sources.title: Non-Abelian dark matter and dark radiation

evidence.text: Thermal relic abundance uses tree-level effective annihilation and coannihilation of the full weak triplet, including dark-color averaging and Dirac versus Majorana multiplicity.

sources.title: A new constraint on millicharged dark matter from galaxy clusters

evidence.text: Estimate magnetic transport as a random walk with mean free path approximately the gyroradius. For v≈10³ km/s, the stated cluster estimate is R_g=3×10⁻¹⁵ ε⁻¹(m/GeV) Mpc. Impose R_g≳1 Mpc to avoid smearing the cluster density profile.

sources.title: Hidden Charged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can exact hidden charge conservation stabilize thermal dark matter while satisfying relic-abundance, small-scale structure, enhanced-annihilation and halo self-interaction constraints?

sources.title: Millicharge or Decay: A Critical Take on Minimal Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can Minimal Dark Matter remain viable when electric neutrality or a Planck-scale cutoff is relaxed, and what relic-abundance and gamma-ray signatures follow?
